title: Space Museum

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: The Space Museum and Grissom Center features incredible spaceflight artifacts, hands-on interactives, the Shuttle Theater Experience, VR experience, and an out-of-this-world gift shop all included with your admission. Please purchase your admission upon arrival at the museum. The Space Museum and Grissom Center does not conduct online advanced general admission at this time. With numerous hands-on experiences and hundreds of spaceflight artifacts, visit times to The Space Museum and Grissom Center vary. We recommend a minimum of one hour to experience the museum, with visits frequently lasting longer. Start your visit at the Grissom Center, located in the Tudor-style Heritage Hall at 118
